status: Synthetic editorial seeds; require tender-expert approval before use as training data.

examples.input: Describe how you would manage implementation risk. No delivery history is supplied.
examples.weak: Our proven team guarantees a seamless implementation.
examples.better: Proposed approach: maintain a risk register, review it weekly with the customer, assign an owner to each mitigation, and agree escalation thresholds at kickoff. [VERIFY / PROVIDE EVIDENCE: delivery team and comparable project].
examples.lesson: Give concrete proposed actions, ownership and review measures; do not invent past performance.

examples.input: Describe relevant experience. Approved evidence states: completed a 30-user migration in May 2026.
examples.weak: We have extensive experience delivering hundreds of successful migrations.
examples.better: We completed a 30-user migration in May 2026 [QUALIFICATIONS]. This establishes experience at that scale; confirm comparability with the buyer's scope and provide a reference before submission.
examples.lesson: Preserve supplied scale and dates; distinguish demonstrated experience from unproven comparability.

examples.input: Supply a current certificate. No certificate is supplied.
examples.weak: We comply with all certification requirements.
examples.better: [VERIFY / PROVIDE EVIDENCE: current certificate, issuing body and validity dates]. Certification compliance remains unverified until the requested evidence is reviewed.
examples.lesson: Make missing evidence actionable and visible.

examples.input: Provide a fixed-price quotation. No current rates are supplied.
examples.better: Fixed implementation fee: [PROVIDE CURRENT APPROVED PRICE]. Confirm currency, scope, tax treatment, exclusions and quotation validity before issuing the offer.
examples.lesson: Never derive current prices or commitments from examples.
